cognee_initialization.description: async function ingest_cognee(). Calls cognee.prune.prune_data(), cognee.prune.prune_system(), builds 6 DataItem objects from FIXTURES_CONTENT, calls cognee.add() then cognee.cognify().
cognee_initialization.note: cognify() was called. However, runtime logs show 'knowledge graph is empty' and 'DocumentChunk_text collection not found', indicating cognify did not produce searchable vector/graph state.

precomputed_search_pass.description: BEFORE case execution, main() iterates over all 23 CASES and calls 'await cognee.search(...)' for each query. Results are stored in a dict 'precomputed' keyed by query string. Exceptions (including NoDataError) are caught and replaced with empty list [].
precomputed_search_pass.exception_handling: All exceptions silently caught, replaced with []

cognee_adapter_retrieve.description: BridgedCogneeAdapter.__init__ accepts 'precomputed_search' dict. Its retrieve() method (line 145) does 'results = self.precomputed_search.get(query, [])'. It NEVER calls cognee.search() at retrieval time. It ONLY looks up the precomputed cache.

case_execution.description: run_case() instantiates BridgedCogneeAdapter(manifest, precomputed_search) for Cognee mode, or BaseAdapterMock(manifest) for Baseline mode. Both are wrapped in TamperingRetrievalWrapper. Then AdaptiveTrustRAGOrchestrator.query() is called.

main_execution_flow.description: main() calls ingest_cognee(), then precomputes search for all queries, then runs all 92 cases via ThreadPoolExecutor.
execution_order: 3. Precompute: for each case, await cognee.search() with exception handling -> stored in dict
4. ThreadPoolExecutor: 23 cases x 2 modes x 2 runs = 92 run_case() calls

execution_path_classification.baseline_description: BaseAdapterMock iterates over all manifest entries and returns Candidate objects directly from the manifest dict. No external search engine is involved. This is a deterministic synthetic retrieval.
execution_path_classification.cognee_description: cognee.search() was called once per unique query BEFORE case execution. All calls raised NoDataError (empty graph). The exception handler replaced all results with []. BridgedCogneeAdapter.retrieve() then looked up this empty cache and returned []. No live Cognee search occurred at case execution time.

root_cause_analysis.cognify_failure: cognee.cognify() was called (line 117), but the runtime logs show 'knowledge graph is empty' and 'DocumentChunk_text collection not found in vector database'. This means cognify() did not successfully build a searchable vector index or knowledge graph from the ingested data items.
root_cause_analysis.search_failure: Because cognify() did not produce a searchable state, all cognee.search() calls raised NoDataError with message: 'No searchable memory in dataset gate5_dataset (id: e66674eb-2d96-50b3-acc5-3d0b3b2d3ecd): holds 6 data item(s) but its knowledge graph is empty; run cognify on this dataset before searching.'
root_cause_analysis.precompute_masking: The try/except block at lines 372-375 silently converted all NoDataError exceptions into empty lists, making the failure invisible to downstream case execution. The Cognee adapter then operated on these empty lists.
root_cause_analysis.protocol_violation: The Gate 5 protocol requires each case to execute through live retrieval. The precompute-then-cache architecture means: (a) search was not live per-case, and (b) the failed search result was reused silently.
